messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're landing a change to the internal API /v2/policies that makes `route_affinity` a required field (string). This will break SDKs that don't send it. Targeting Tue 2026-04-07 deploy. :warning:

simone: @alex can you paste the payload example? How will console routing behave for requests without it?

alex: Example:
```
POST /v2/policies
{
  "model": "redwood/rlhf-1",
  "route_affinity": "tenant:us-east-1"
}
```
If missing, router will fallback to generic pool which may hit quota throttles (shared bucket).

morgan: :eyes: will this affect deduped quota accounting? we saw mismatches earlier when affinity was inferred.

ryan: yes — routing-affinity determines tenant-specific quota buckets. Missing field => requests mapped to shared bucket. So dashboards will show increased shared-quota burn and attribution will be off.

pat: SDK owners: python/ts/go — what's the plan for backwards compat? Can we auto-fill from client config?

simone: Py SDK can default to env var REDWOOD_ROUTE_AFFINITY if present; TS can too. But older pinned clients won't upgrade, so server-side mitigation is needed.

alex: proposal: add a server-side shim for 4 weeks that maps missing `route_affinity` -> header `x-route-guess` computed from auth token. Then after 4 weeks we require the field and remove shim.

morgan: shim helps but telemetry will be noisy. Console needs a new tile showing 'shim-mapped requests' — otherwise SRE won't be able to tell real vs guessed routing.

ryan: agreed. We should emit a telemetry event `policy_shim=true` on those requests and tag traces. Also increment metric `infra.route_shim.count`.

pat: rollout UX: can we make the shim disabled for Dedicated/Private customers that require strict schema? They should be opted-out by default.

alex: yes, opt-out via account flag. Default ON for hosted.

simone: timeline? docs + release notes + migration guide? Also a compatibility flag in SDKs to opt-in to strict mode so customers can test.

pat: suggest: announce Fri, doc + migration samples Mon, SDK patch releases Wed, canary on Tue (10% traffic), full flip 2w later. Dashboard tile ready before canary.

ryan: add telemetry sampling: tag `route_shim` and include `trace_id`. Console owners @maria can we get a small tile showing shim rate + shared-quota burn?

maria: @ryan yup we'll slot a console tile. Need Grafana query and backend metric names. Send me exact metric names and expected cardinality.

morgan: Metric names: `infra.route_shim.count`, `quota.shared_burn.tokens`, `routing.missed_affinity.count`. We'll also emit `route_shim_reason` tag for debugging.

alex: I'll update the RFC and include curl examples, SDK instructions, and a short migration checklist. Also we'll add CI lint that fails if SDK integration tests don't include the new header or env-default behavior.

simone: For older customers we should add a CLI migration helper that scans usage for old SDK versions and flags high-impact tenants.

pat: ok — SDK owners pls confirm you'll ship a minor bump with env var default and opt-in strict mode by Wed. @simone @ben (go)

ben: Go SDK ok for minor bump; will add env var support + doc snippets and a compat flag.

simone: Py/TS +1 — will also add a deprecation warning log for missing `route_affinity` so apps notice during integration tests.

alex: Great. I'll schedule the canary and create a runbook for rollback. Runbook will include how to flip shim off and how to revert router mapping if we see quota anomalies.

pat: one more ask: add a console alert (pager) if `infra.route_shim.count` spikes > 5% of total traffic in a 5m window. That should catch accidental mass-migration.

ryan: will add alert rule in infra.

maria: I'll implement the tile and a lightweight drilldown linking to traces filtered by `policy_shim=true`. Need the dashboard mock by EOD Friday.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC link and the exact metric names + sample queries. We'll coordinate SDK release PRs in #devex. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC (10% traffic) — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-affinity-shim
